# @paladini/lattes-parser

Independent npm package to automate Plataforma Lattes curriculum work on exported XML: TypeScript model, CLI, backups, applyCurriculumPatches for AI skills. User finishes with Import XML on the CNPq platform UI. Not affiliated with CNPq.

## Product flow

1. User exports curriculum XML from Plataforma Lattes.
2. Automate locally: parse, batch edit, AI patches with allowlist, writeCurriculum with .lattes-backup snapshots.
3. User imports updated XML via platform Import XML, reviews, saves.

## Key APIs

readCurriculum, writeCurriculum, serializeCurriculum, applyCurriculumPatches, getCurriculumValue, setCurriculumValue, lattes-parser CLI
